The other values are real and are NOT demonstrated here — do not read this example as evidence that they do not exist. `declaredValues` is quoted from the recovered builder source named in `source`; where a variant takes different companion fields, this catalog has no capture of them. rules.note: SILENT-CLASS. The `_specific` pair scopes DND to selected CHANNELS; plain `enable` DNDs everything. Authoring `enable` where `enable_specific` was meant silently kills all outbound comms for the contact and raises nothing. The 186-step corpus only ever saw enable/disable, so the `_specific` pair is invisible to every other source in this catalog.
